steps.label: Set RopeBothEndsPinned preset (8-particle chain, both ends pinned, slack in the middle)
Precondition: end (particle 7) at y=-2 (straight taut vertical line from the start pin down to the end pin, length 2)
Precondition: chain starts as a perfectly straight vertical line, no bulge above the top pin
With both ends position-fixed and gravity compressing the taut vertical chain against its own fixed bottom anchor, the middle buckles sideways/up (~1.6s)

Change: a middle particle has buckled above the top pin's height (XPBD distance constraints resist compression, not just stretching -- a vertically taut chain pinned at both ends buckles rather than staying perfectly straight)
Invariant: pinned start did not move
Invariant: pinned end did not move

Invariant: no velocity explosion (wider bound than the other soft-body presets in this group: the compression-buckling snap here is a legitimately faster transient than a gentle cloth drape or jelly drop, not divergence)
